claim_fields.claim_text: Human-readable claim sentence used in governance docs
claim_fields.short_name: Snake-case slug for scripts and tables
claim_fields.required_study: Named study or validation program required to evaluate the claim
claim_fields.required_evidence: What must exist before the claim can be supported
claim_fields.validation_threshold: Preregistered minimum condition for supporting or rejecting the claim
claim_fields.current_state: Validator-derived evidence/workflow state; it does not independently promote status
claim_fields.allowed_wording: Non-empty list of wording allowed at the current evidence state
claim_fields.forbidden_wording: Non-empty list of wording prohibited at the current evidence state
claim_fields.paper_location: Non-empty list of paper source locations governed by the claim
claim_fields.linked_run_dirs: Experiment run directories (repo-relative) backing the claim
claim_fields.linked_tables_figures: Tables and figures tied to the claim
claim_fields.current_evidence_paths: All reproducible artifact paths (includes runs, tables, figures)

validation_rules.engineering_only_scope: Smoke/stub runs only; not scientific evidence
validation_rules.promotion_rule: Adding schema-v3 planning fields never promotes status or current_state
